key_insight: Search-for-Gradient restarts stalled optimisation by searching for trainable regions within structured flat VQA landscapes.
engineering_relevance: The framework can complement existing VQA optimisers to reduce stagnation when informative gradients exist elsewhere in parameter space.
method: Detect stalled parameter updates when gradients vanish.
Search sampled parameter points for nonzero gradients.
Restart local optimisation in a trainable region.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical estimates of jump counts and escape probabilities, plus improved optimisation on synthetic landscapes and a quantum-circuit cost landscape.
watch_item: The method requires a trainable region of nonzero measure and cannot work if that region has zero measure.
paper_title: Search-for-Gradient: Search-Based Restarts for Optimisation in Structured Flat Landscapes of Variational Quantum Algorithms
